response.sql: SELECT team_id, SUM(games) as total_games, SUM(games) * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(games) FROM home_game) as fraction_of_total, SUM(games) * 1.0 / (SELECT AVG(games) FROM home_game) as ratio_to_average FROM home_game GROUP BY team_id ORDER BY ratio_to_average DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Teams with only NULL games values are included in the result with NULL totals and ratios, sorted to the end.

alternatives.interpretation: Exclude records and teams with NULL games values: only sum/average non-NULL values and only include teams with at least one non-NULL record.
alternatives.sql: SELECT team_id, SUM(games) as total_games, SUM(games) * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(games) FROM home_game WHERE games IS NOT NULL) as fraction_of_total, SUM(games) * 1.0 / (SELECT AVG(games) FROM home_game WHERE games IS NOT NULL) as ratio_to_average FROM home_game WHERE games IS NOT NULL GROUP BY team_id ORDER BY ratio_to_average DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;
